import sys

def find_dominant_piranha(n, sizes):
    max_size = max(sizes)
    for i in range(n):
        if sizes[i] == max_size:
            if (i > 0 and sizes[i] > sizes[i - 1]) or (i < n - 1 and sizes[i] > sizes[i + 1]):
                return i + 1
    return -1

    import sys
